question: Does the frozen calibrated SawFM separator convert its oracle-positive period gain into a reliable end-to-end 12-parameter gain under the frozen P2a predicted-label gates?

frozen_components.classification_and_base_parameter_model: MLCNN plus IQ-Grouped task-routed checkpoints from the P2a reference
frozen_components.isrj_route: P2a seed-matched lower-confidence ensemble, selection rule and routed thresholds
frozen_components.old_sawfm_parameter: P2a frozen raw-IQ SawFM period specialist

variants.R0_safe_isrj_route: frozen predicted labels and original IQ-Grouped parameter outputs
variants.R1_old_joint: R0 plus frozen old SawFM period and VFT Doppler replacements
variants.R2_uncalibrated_separator: R1 with old SawFM period replaced by the P2f S1 separated estimate on predicted-positive SawFM samples
variants.R3_calibrated_separator: R2 plus the frozen P2h affine coefficient

primary_metrics: SawFM period predicted-gate NMAE by power

failure_branches.high_power_pass_low_power_fail: Do not use external power labels. On a new seed, develop a bounded reliability selector from inference-available separator diagnostics and old/new disagreement.
failure_branches.saw_period_pass_full_metric_fail: Quantify parameter weighting and predicted-gate coverage; do not claim end-to-end benefit.
failure_branches.full_mean_pass_worst_combo_fail: Construct matched hard-combination protection before confirmation.
failure_branches.calibration_ablation_fails: Discard affine calibration and retain the uncalibrated candidate only if it independently passes all system gates.

evidence_boundary.next_if_passed: Freeze P2j candidate and confirm it without refitting on two new train-only identity seeds.
